entities.summary: Antonio Maria Colini was a Roman archaeologist who studied, among other topics, the Severan marble plan of Rome known as the Forma Urbis Romae. He was part of the group of scholars associated with Italo Gismondi. Antonio Maria Colini was a architects & engineers from Rome (1900-09-12, Rome–1989-07-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
